methodology_notes.profiles_page_frame: First full reporting month, May 2026 - Phase A, pilot/exploratory. Behavioral and RQ characterizations are early single-month reads on ~40-110 closed trades per model: descriptive of this month, not pooled inference. Cumulative figures are inception-anchored (2026-04-09, includes the April shakedown); behavioral metrics are May calendar-month only.

correlation_matrix.methodology_ref: RQ1 join: data_inputs_hash + raw_decisions, >=3 shared tickers; action_concordance = 3-way BUY/SELL/HOLD exact-match rate; weight_correlation = Pearson r of target_weight vectors. The RQ1 headline scalar is the OBSERVATION-WEIGHTED pooled mean of the off-diagonal cells (each cell weighted by its n_shared_ticks); the unweighted mean of the cells differs and is not the headline. Thin cells (low n_shared_ticks, e.g. Gemini pairs reduced by its open-bell failures) should be read with their n_shared_ticks.

incidents.detail: Silent scheduler outage: 3 decision periods missing on 2026-05-26 (10 ticks logged vs the 13-tick healthy cadence), uniform across all six models. Gap spans the ~15:0x-16:0x UTC (~11:00-12:00 ET) window.
Two Gemini ticks on 2026-05-27 (17:04 and 18:35 UTC) failed with 'Model response was not valid JSON even after repair: Unterminated string' — counted in Gemini's api_failures; no decision recorded.

Cancelled-run noise on 2026-05-27 did NOT corrupt the committed logs: no duplicate (date,timestamp) records were found in any model's May JSONL. Related Gemini '499 operation was cancelled' API errors (9 in May) are folded into Gemini's failure-mode breakdown.

Gemini May api-failure rate is elevated (open-bell congestion). Failure-mode mix this month: 30x 429 You exceeded your current quota, ple, 27x 504 Deadline expired before operation co, 24x Timeout of 600.0s exceeded, last excepti, 19x 504 Deadline Exceeded, 9x 499 The operation was cancelled., 2x Model response was not valid JSON even a. Missingness is MAR|tick-position (monotonic tick-position gradient, market-state independent r=-0.12); reduces power for every Gemini estimate and is handled by tick-position conditioning per docs/Gemini-selection-bias-characterization-and-per-RQ-handling.md.

DeepSeek floating alias repointed mid-month: model_id_returned changed deepseek-v4-flash -> deepseek-v4-pro on 2026-05-21 (deliberate: v4-flash is sub-frontier; v4-pro restores cohort parity). May DeepSeek data spans two snapshots; recorded in report_meta.pinned_snapshots.

data_integrity.notes: Failure rate = api_failures / records over the calendar month. A failed tick still writes a record (no decision). Missing ticks are decision periods with zero records for any model (systemic), distinct from per-model api failures. The 2026-04-09-22 Anthropic state-file commingling defect is pre-May and excluded by the >=2026-04-23 pilot-window rule; it does not affect May data.

RQ2.windowing_note: full-history avg-cost replay; sale records attributed by sale-date in the calendar month (behavioral_summary discipline).

reported_primary.note: Reported primary for RQ2 is the per-model GPT and Grok disposition differences -- the two models that clear the three-gate inclusion framework (uncorrupted book, stable model identity, completeness >= 0.80) and are each individually estimable. Authoritative values live in per_model.gpt and per_model.grok and are unchanged.

RQ2.supersession_note: The six-model pooled disposition difference (pooled_disposition_difference, n_sale_records=990) pools non-estimable models (claude, claude_opus: corrupt book) and exploratory models (gemini: completeness; deepseek: model-splice) together with the estimable GPT/Grok cohort, which contradicts the inclusion framework. It is superseded by the per-model GPT/Grok reported primary and is retained for provenance only -- not reported.
